name: power-apps-canvas-edit
description: Build and change Power Apps canvas apps through FlowStudio MCP: create apps, add and restyle screens and controls, write Power Fx, build galleries, and connect Dataverse, SharePoint, connectors and flows, all as named edits the server checks. Load this skill when asked to: create an app, add or change a screen or control, write or fix a Power Fx formula, add a gallery or table, connect a data source or flow, fix a layout, or improve an app's quality score. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription; see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
